description1: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years architecting multi-tiered financial distribution engines, high-scale analytics platforms, and enterprise banking solutions. I turn complex domain requirements into modular, performant systems.
bio: I'm a Senior Software Engineer specializing in fintech and enterprise banking systems. My work spans multi-tiered equity payout and capital gains distribution engines, real-time analytics platforms processing customer propensity metrics, and core banking portals for tier-1 international clients. I focus on system architecture, GraphQL and API performance, and building deployment pipelines that teams can rely on.
